name: BAR: Benchmark Audit and Revision

paper.title: Follow the Policy, Fail the Benchmark: Auditing and Revising Policy-Based Decision Benchmarks

boundaries: Component-level corrections, not complete benchmark correctness certification.
SARA and ConditionalQA source labels are unchanged and obtained separately.
OpenExempt study targets use amended premises and are not a replacement native key.
TAC runtime observations use constructed replies and trajectory input; no live-agent frequency or price correctness is measured.
Airline objective amendment changes model-visible inputs but retains conditional native reference amounts.
NBA changes two localization fields only; Airline amount-scoring probes are constructed, not model performance.
paper_binding_scope: Paper and reported studies associated with v0.1.0; the new component checks are not new manuscript performance results.
